title: Payer months
subtitle: Close a payer's month so tills refuse insurance returns and corrections in it; reopen it for a late correction. Every act takes a reason.

access.deniedHint: Closing payer months needs the INSURANCE_TEAM role. Ask an administrator.
access.unreachableHint: The server didn't answer. Try again in a moment.

list.activityHint: Reads every payer with sales in the month. It scans the month's sales, so it runs only when you press it.
list.ledgerCaption: Payers already on the ledger, and payers with a correction this month.
list.activityCaption: Every payer with sales this month, and every payer already on the ledger.
list.emptyLedger: No payer has been closed or corrected in {{period}} yet. Show payers with activity to close the month.

closeAll.notOffered: Show payers with activity first: Close all closes that list.

dialog.closeBody: Close {{payer}} for {{period}}. Tills will refuse insurance returns and corrections for it.
dialog.reopenBody: Reopen {{payer}} for {{period}}. Tills will accept returns and corrections for it again.
dialog.closeAllBody_one: Close {{n}} payer for {{period}}, in one act. Tills will refuse insurance returns and corrections for it.
dialog.closeAllBody_other: Close {{n}} payers for {{period}}, in one act. Tills will refuse insurance returns and corrections for them.
dialog.alreadyClosed_one: {{n}} of them is already closed; its close is recorded again.
dialog.alreadyClosed_other: {{n}} of them are already closed; their close is recorded again.
dialog.corrections_one: This month carries {{n}} correction. Read it under History before you close.
dialog.corrections_other: This month carries {{n}} corrections. Read them under History before you close.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: Why — this is the answer to the question the payer will ask.
dialog.reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than {{max}} characters.
